body: @theofidry it's similar, but not a duplicate. @lemartin is the join column mapped with backticks?

Yes, the column is mapped with back-ticks.

```php
    /**
     * @OneToOne(targetEntity="User", inversedBy="address")
     * @JoinColumn(name="`user-id`", referencedColumnName="`user-id`")
     */
    public $user;
```
Yup, that's 100% a bug then, and not a duplicate :-\

Created a [pull request](https://github.com/doctrine/doctrine2/pull/6404) for both issues. (My first ever, sorry if I got anything wrong).

The PR targets the master, how are the chances, given a PR for 2.5 would be supplied, that this fix could find its way into a 2.5.x?
@lemartin once the PR is merged be me or @Ocramius we'll do the backporting 😉
@lemartin thanks for your contribution as explained [here](https://github.com/doctrine/doctrine2/pull/6404#issuecomment-298234081) we're going to keep it on `v2.6.x` only.
